Authentication is PER DEVELOPER — the server uses each developer's own Azure credentials (az login); never commit a PAT. This one placeholder is a plain sentinel rather than the kit's usual <<TOKEN>> form because the value lands in an ARGV: on Windows npx runs through cmd.exe, which reads << and >> as redirect operators and dies with '<< was unexpected at this time.' before the server starts — an error naming neither the server nor the token. As a sentinel the server starts and says 'Failed to fetch tenant for ADO org ADO_ORGANIZATION_NOT_SET', which is searchable. /sprd-doctor flags it either way.
